verdict.one_line_verdict: The most complete and trustworthy design I saw. Guardrails and openness are top tier, but the allergen screen contradicts itself in a strict school kitchen, which keeps it out of 9–10.

evidence: Official example in UI and via POST v0.1/agent/run: AUTO, CONFIRMED_SIMULATED, 1000 x Valio Eila 1 l at €1.01 = €1,010.00, delivery Mon 16 Nov
Did search -> offers -> proposals myself over REST: offer OF-2026-11-18-41a898889d36 with offerHash, 60 bags = 30 kg, €126.00, AUTO under €500 school limit
Finnish request, school mandate, ASK flow, mobile approver page and approval all worked without crashes
MCP tools/list returns documented tools
weaknesses: Lookup step dumps hundreds of fact rows for excluded products; the actual decision is far down the page

'Nut allergy' mapped to tree nuts only, peanuts not considered

MCP approveProposal -> 'Unknown tool'; no REST approve endpoint found

weaknesses: Approver panel lets anyone pick any approver identity; buyer admin policy controls are on the public buyer page without auth (stated as a demo limitation)

evidence: Cut-off conflicts (K3) detect stale delivery dates and exclude those products
800 kg salmon today -> split across products, later-delivery flagged, blocked by hard limit
Vague request leads to a clarification, not a guess

weaknesses: Split/substitute line of a different product state (frozen for fresh) auto-approved, so substitutes are not checked against the original intent

evidence: OpenAPI 3.1 at /openapi.json, /docs, MCP at /mcp, /spec with trust levels, sources (GS1 Synkka fields), conflict codes K1-K5 and full reason-code catalogue
Structured validation errors with field paths
Search returns per-allergen FREE_FROM status with source field; offers carry hash and version
/valio readiness view: 17,546 products, AUTO-ready share, data gaps and live AUTO/ASK/BLOCK statistics
Limitations stated honestly: no auth, in-memory state, simulated orders
weaknesses: MCP tool descriptions reference 'helsinki-hospital-kitchen', which returns 404; real id is nordic-harbour-hotels
No auth scheme in the spec, not even a placeholder for scoped agent credentials

strengths: Deterministic server-side AUTO/ASK/BLOCK gateway that rejects forged decision fields, cross-customer offer reuse and request/offer mismatches
Trust-label model (Verified/Declared/Estimate/Unknown with source field and timestamp) plus a published spec for it
Hash-chained, verifiable audit log with per-proposal rule and fact detail
Open interfaces: OpenAPI 3.1, MCP without approval powers, and a REST flow I could drive by hand
Responsible API use: static narrowing, then live price only for a short list
Valio-side readiness view turns data quality into a fix list
